name: session-spend
description: A pixel-art card with the session's API spend, plan usage and subagents, plus a status line total

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: How long the prompt cache lives. auto assumes 1h on a subscription plan and 5m on per-token billing.

cacheWarning.title: Warn before the cache expires
cacheWarning.description: Show a toast a minute before a 5m cache expires, or five minutes before a 1h cache.
